It reflects a strong connection to faith and a sense of elevation and steadfastness. The name Angadreme carries the meaning “God's mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Angadreme usually hope their child will grow to embody god's mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
